name: max
description: MAX messages: bia's own MAX account (the Russian messenger, max.ru), a real user, not a bot. Before the first login, tell root that bia needs its own account with its own phone number, separate from root's: chats, messages, files, voice messages, reactions, edits, groups, channels to join, bans and blocks. Login by QR (max_login), scanned in the MAX app of that account. One-to-one voice calls after a QR login (max_call_start, max_call_accept, max_call_say, max_call_hangup): what is said arrives as [speech <lang>]; no group or video calls. Unofficial client: MAX may restrict an account for it. Received files are saved in /home/bia/files/inbox/max/; voice messages arrive transcribed as [speech <lang>]; edits, deletions, reactions, contacts and locations arrive as [edited <id>], [deleted], [reaction], [contact] and [location] lines. The login is restored by itself at boot.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|log into max -> discover(path='mcp/max', enable=true); say bia needs its own account with its own phone number, then max_login()  (QR opens in a MAX QR window on :0 and in root's web app)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|nobody can scan; its number is +79991234567 -> max_login(phone='+79991234567'); then max_submit_code(code=...) with the SMS code root gives
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send hi in that max chat -> max_send(chat_id='123456789', text='hi')
alice|max:123456789|<issued>|<delivered>|[incoming call] from alice -> max_call_accept(chat_id='123456789') or max_call_reject(chat_id='123456789')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|send alice a voice message saying I am late -> max_send_voice(chat_id='123456789', text='Опаздываю минут на десять.', lang='ru')
